I am a 60-year-old woman with no schooling, and my farm is only this small 0.12 hectare plot where I grow maize with other crops. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer from the agro-dealer, so I will use goat and chicken manure that I collect at home to strengthen the soil. I keep my own maize seeds from last harvest because they are free and I know they grow well here. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, so we do not need to pay anyone to help.
